Messages.Author: tumer altas
Messages.Body:
Nefertiti can place corruption counters on a vampire. can she do this
without there first mbeing an action card to place corruption on the
vampired in the first place. in othre word s can nefertiti steal a vampire
without any other card being played.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. She can place corruption counters, true.
But doing so has no other effect. She cannot steal a vampire.
You need a card to do that, like "Corruption" or similar.
